retired_chapters._doc: Chapters the decided skeleton retires WITHOUT a single successor node, so they cannot be expressed as another node's legacy entry. Read by tools/chapter_refs.py, which needs somewhere to redirect a reference once the chapter's directory is gone. A dissolved chapter with no registry entry is the worst case: every sentence pointing at it dangles with nothing to rewrite it to.
